The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cacb926d1f09eeb7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let X be a smooth connected complex algebraic curve and let r ≥ 1. For prescribed quasi-unipotent conjugacy classes C1, . . . , Cs as above, let K ⊂ C be a number field containing their eigenvalues. There is a finite extension L/K such that Mr(X)(OL) ∩ Y (C) is Zariski dense in Y , and hence in every irreducible component of Y . The same conclusion holds when only the characteristic polynomial of each boundary monodromy is prescribed, with all its roots roots of unity. It also holds for the entire character variety without boundary conditions; in that case one may take K = Q. For the relative statements and for projective X, one may take distinct primes p, q > r and F = K( √ 2, ζpq), L = F (︁ ζr, {u1/r : u ∈ O× F } )︁ , (1) where ζm denotes a primitive mth root of unity. In the projective case there are no boundary conditions and K = Q.
